implement.approach: Round 1's matrix (11 tests across capture, extraction, settlement, sync, epoch) was sound but passed unchanged on BASE_SHA, so it failed AC2. Round 2 kept that matrix as the per-stage coverage documentation and located a concrete defect inside the authorized write path apps/mobile/src/data/accountScope.ts: setActiveDataOwner() (base line 57) notified subscribers with `ownerListeners.forEach(listener => listener())`, so the first subscriber that threw aborted delivery and every subscriber registered after it never observed the switch. Every owner fence in the shipping app is subscription-based — capture.ts:757-761 aborts the native byte comparison via subscribeToDataOwner, AnalyzeScreen.tsx:2187 abandons the in-flight analysis via subscribeToDataOwner, OriginalAnalysisExecution (originalAnalysisOperations.ts) invalidates its lease via subscribeToDataOwner — so a starved fence lets in-flight work continue for the previous owner after A→B. Test first (commit 1fa6ee2b + prettier 2c96e49e): a new describe 'owner-change delivery' with (a) an extraction-stage probe: faulty subscriber registered first, an owner-only AbortController fence (modelled on capture.ts) and the execution lease registered after it, extraction held mid-flight, owner switched away from A → asserts the switch is applied, the throw surfaces, and BOTH later fences fire; then B sees no rows/results, no B bearer is used, A returns and completes the SAME operation id; (b) a primitive probe: three subscribers (two throwing) all run in order against the new snapshot, generation bumps once, first error rethrown once, a no-op re-set notifies nobody. Fix (commit 7c06c0b6): setActiveDataOwner() delegates to notifyOwnerListeners(), which iterates every listener, captures the first thrown error, and rethrows it after the last listener — 16 added lines, no exported signature change, no other file touched. Wired into shipping behaviour by construction: every existing subscribeToDataOwner caller (authStore sign-out/sign-in paths call setActiveDataOwner) now receives every switch.

No shipping subscriber is known to throw (INFERRED from reading capture.ts, AnalyzeScreen.tsx, originalAnalysisOperations.ts, syncRuntime.ts, React useSyncExternalStore glue); the hardening protects the owner-only fences (camera byte-comparison abort capture.ts:757-761, Analyze abandon AnalyzeScreen.tsx:2187, OriginalAnalysisExecution.recheck) from being starved by an earlier faulty subscriber.
